navigation_framing: LunaBot demonstrates autonomous local navigation in a GPS/GNSS-independent lunar settlement simulation, using onboard perception (RGB-D + 3D LiDAR), SLAM, a Local Settlement Map & Landmark Database, 5-class semantic terrain understanding, and terrain-aware path planning (A* / D*-Lite).

REGOLITH.description: Fine gray dusty lunar soil — primary low-cost traversable surface

BEDROCK.description: Exposed stepped geological rock shelves — moderate traversal cost

SMALL_ROCK.description: Scattered basalt ejecta fragments — high caution cost

LARGE_ROCK.description: Angular boulders (0.5m–4m) — impassable obstacle + safety inflation halo

SHADOW.description: Low-angle South-Pole umbra/penumbra shadow zone — degraded visual perception penalty

CRATER.description: Raised ejecta rim + steep inner crater bowl — forbidden hazard

STEEP_SLOPE.description: High-gradient ridge or crater wall (>20 deg) — forbidden rollover hazard

habitat_hub.name: Lunar Habitat Hub
habitat_hub.purpose: Central settlement base, rover garage, airlock, equipment storage, and mission departure/return hub.

solar_station.name: Solar Power Station
solar_station.purpose: High-illumination polar ridge solar array farm, battery storage, and power substation.

landing_zone.name: Landing / Logistics Zone
landing_zone.purpose: Spacecraft descent/ascent pad, Vikram/Artemis lander, and logistics cargo transfer waypoint.

comms_relay.name: Communication Relay Tower
comms_relay.purpose: Elevated line-of-sight communications relay linking Habitat Hub, Earth, and remote exploration sites.

mining_site.name: Resource / Mining Site
mining_site.purpose: ISRU regolith excavation, core drilling structure, and resource processing containers.

science_station.name: Science / Geological Station
science_station.difficulty_label: 5/6 — Very Hard (Rocky Ridge, Boulder Field & Crater Corridor)
science_station.purpose: Geological sampling & spectrometer station beyond the hazardous crater field and rocky ridge.

shadow_crater.name: Permanently Shadowed Crater / Research Zone
shadow_crater.difficulty_label: 6/6 — Hardest (Steep Crater Rim, Deep Permanent Shadow & Ejecta)
shadow_crater.purpose: Extreme polar crater floor (-9.23m depth) in permanent shadow for volatile/illumination perception research.

M1_SOLAR.name: Mission 1 — Habitat Hub -> Solar Power Station
M1_SOLAR.purpose: Basic GPS-free local navigation over mostly traversable regolith and gentle ridge slopes.
M1_SOLAR.expected_behavior: Planner selects low-cost regolith corridor avoiding departure hazards.

M2_MINING.name: Mission 2 — Habitat Hub -> Resource / Mining Site
M2_MINING.purpose: Terrain-aware navigation across rocks, rough regolith, moderate slopes, and crater edges.
M2_MINING.expected_behavior: Planner penalizes rock fields and crater rims, routing through safe regolith troughs.

M3_SCIENCE.name: Mission 3 — Habitat Hub -> Science / Geological Station
M3_SCIENCE.purpose: Route A (short but crosses boulder + 3.2m crater hazard) vs. Route B (longer, lower semantic cost).
M3_SCIENCE.expected_behavior: Semantic cost map blocks direct Route A (cost=100) and selects Safe Route B.

M4_SHADOW.name: Mission 4 — Habitat Hub -> Permanently Shadowed Crater
M4_SHADOW.purpose: Extreme illumination contrast (SUNLIT REGOLITH -> DEEP SHADOW), crater slopes, and rocks.
M4_SHADOW.expected_behavior: Segmentation & cost map distinguish dark shadow zones from physical crater walls/boulders.

M5_LANDING_ROUNDTRIP.name: Mission 5 — Habitat Hub -> Landing Zone -> Habitat Hub
M5_LANDING_ROUNDTRIP.purpose: Outbound and return navigation using SLAM pose estimation and landmark constraints.
M5_LANDING_ROUNDTRIP.expected_behavior: Rover reaches landing corridor waypoint and maintains bounded SLAM/odometry drift.

M6_DYNAMIC_OBSTACLE.name: Mission 6 — Dynamic Obstacle & Real-Time Replanning
M6_DYNAMIC_OBSTACLE.purpose: Detect unmapped/newly sensed boulder hazard on route and trigger real-time path replanning.
M6_DYNAMIC_OBSTACLE.expected_behavior: LiDAR/RGB-D updates obstacle overlay and planner recomputes safe trajectory in <0.25s.
